items.name: Proposal Budget Personnel & Compliance Requirements Extraction
items.description: Uploads a proposal budget document (NSF-style budget tables / NIH PHS 398 / agency budget form) and returns a single structured JSON object covering personnel identification (senior key, postdocs, grad students, undergraduates, other personnel) and budget structure compliance triggers (subaward recipients, equipment over $5,000, F&A rate and base, cost sharing, total costs). Output conforms to the proposal-budget-personnel-extraction-udm component schema. The runtime mirrors the ui-insight/ProcessMapping proposal-budget-personnel-extraction workflow (two parallel Extraction tasks plus a Consolidation Prompt that derives the boolean compliance triggers).

data.name: extract-personnel-identification
data.prompt:
You are extracting all personnel listed in a proposal budget
document.

Be 100% accurate. Match the schema's type for each field
exactly:
  - Integer-typed fields (postdoc_count, graduate_student_count,
    undergraduate_count) are JSON integers.
  - Number-typed fields (total_personnel_cost,
    senior_key_personnel[].salary_requested,
    postdoc_details[].salary_or_stipend,
    graduate_student_details[].stipend / tuition_remission,
    other_personnel[].cost) are JSON numbers — no quotes, no
    currency symbol, no thousand-separators.
  - String-typed fields (name, role, institution, effort) are
    quoted verbatim, preserving "%" / "summer months" / etc.
Use empty arrays when a category has no entries; never invent
personnel. Use "TBN" as the name for to-be-named postdoc or
graduate-student slots so per-person document workflows can
flag the missing-name dependency without dropping the row.

Search Senior/Key Personnel, Other Personnel, Section A, Section
B, Salary and Wages, Personnel Justification.

The four derivable booleans (has_postdocs_or_grad_students,
mentoring_plan_required) will be computed by the downstream
Consolidation Prompt — do not set them here.

items.searchphrase: JSON array of {name, role, institution, effort, salary_requested} for senior/key personnel.
items.title: senior_key_personnel

items.searchphrase: Integer count of postdoctoral researchers in the budget.
items.title: postdoc_count

items.searchphrase: JSON array of {name, effort, salary_or_stipend} for postdoctoral researchers. Use "TBN" for unnamed slots.
items.title: postdoc_details

items.searchphrase: Integer count of graduate research/teaching assistants in the budget.
items.title: graduate_student_count

items.searchphrase: JSON array of {name, type, stipend, tuition_remission} where type is "RA" or "TA".
items.title: graduate_student_details

items.searchphrase: Integer count of undergraduate students in the budget.
items.title: undergraduate_count

items.searchphrase: JSON array of {role, cost} for other personnel (technicians, programmers, administrative staff).
items.title: other_personnel

items.searchphrase: Total personnel costs including salary and fringe (decimal number).
items.title: total_personnel_cost

data.name: extract-budget-structure-and-compliance-triggers
data.prompt:
You are extracting the budget category structure and the
compliance-trigger inputs (subawards, equipment over $5,000,
travel, F&A rate and base, cost sharing, total costs) from a
proposal budget document.

Be 100% accurate. Match the schema's type for each field
exactly:
  - Number-typed fields (subaward_recipients[].amount,
    equipment_items[].cost, budget_categories[].amount,
    budget_periods[].amount, total_costs.{total_direct_costs,
    total_indirect_costs, total_project_cost}) are JSON
    numbers — no quotes, no currency symbol, no thousand-
    separators.
  - String-typed fields (fa_rate, travel_summary,
    cost_sharing) are quoted verbatim with their "%" / "$" /
    other formatting preserved.
Equipment items below $5,000 do NOT belong in equipment_items
regardless of how the budget labels them. F&A rate and base
are two distinct STRING fields ("42.5% MTDC" → fa_rate:
"42.5%", fa_base: "MTDC").

The boolean triggers (has_subawards, has_equipment_over_5k)
will be computed by the downstream Consolidation Prompt — do
not set them here.

items.searchphrase: JSON array of {category_name, amount, notes} for each budget category.
items.title: budget_categories

items.searchphrase: JSON array of {institution_name, sub_pi_name, amount} for subaward/subcontract recipients. Empty array when none.
items.title: subaward_recipients

items.searchphrase: JSON array of {description, cost} for equipment items costing over $5,000 only.
items.title: equipment_items

items.searchphrase: Summary of travel costs including domestic and foreign travel amounts.
items.title: travel_summary

items.searchphrase: F&A (indirect cost) rate percentage as stated (e.g., "42.5%").
items.title: fa_rate

items.searchphrase: Base for F&A rate calculation (MTDC, TDC, Salary & Wages).
items.title: fa_base

items.searchphrase: Cost sharing or matching amount and type if present in the budget.
items.title: cost_sharing

items.searchphrase: JSON object {total_direct_costs, total_indirect_costs, total_project_cost} (all decimal numbers).
items.title: total_costs

items.searchphrase: JSON array of {period_number, start_date, end_date, amount} for multi-year proposals. Empty array for single-period.
items.title: budget_periods

data.name: budget-personnel-consolidation
data.prompt:
You are assembling the Proposal Budget Personnel & Compliance
Triggers extraction output. The input is the JSON fragment
produced by the upstream parallel Extraction tasks.

Rules:
1. Pass-through every personnel and budget field verbatim.
2. Combine fa_rate and fa_base into a single fa_rate_and_base
   object: {rate: <fa_rate>, base: <fa_base>}.
3. Derive the four boolean triggers:
   - has_postdocs_or_grad_students = (postdoc_count > 0) OR
     (graduate_student_count > 0)
   - mentoring_plan_required = has_postdocs_or_grad_students
     (for NSF; per agency policy otherwise — when the sponsor
     is unknown, default to has_postdocs_or_grad_students)
   - has_subawards = len(subaward_recipients) > 0
   - has_equipment_over_5k = len(equipment_items) > 0
4. Verify cost-totals reconciliation: total_costs.total_project_cost
   must equal total_costs.total_direct_costs +
   total_costs.total_indirect_costs (CHK-03). When they do not
   reconcile, preserve the document's reported values rather
   than synthesizing.
5. Use null for missing scalar fields; never invent values.
6. Do not output any text outside the single JSON object.

validation_plan.check_description: Verify postdoc_count == len(postdoc_details), graduate_student_count == len(graduate_student_details), and that senior_key_personnel covers every PI/Co-PI named in budget_personnel.

Verify the four derived booleans equal their corresponding list-length expressions (has_postdocs_or_grad_students = (postdoc_count > 0) OR (graduate_student_count > 0); mentoring_plan_required = has_postdocs_or_grad_students; has_subawards = len(subaward_recipients) > 0; has_equipment_over_5k = len(equipment_items) > 0).
